# Configurable Key Casing

Added key_case (kebab-case default, snake_case override) as a project-wide intent.config.yaml setting, enforced by a new linter rule (E005) and the write path (add/record/mv --rename); the schema itself now accepts either shape and leaves the specific convention to the linter. Migrated this repo's own intent.yaml -- previously all snake_case -- to kebab-case via a batch of cascading mutate.Mv renames, so its generated docs/ tree is kebab-case too (gen already rendered keys verbatim; no translation code was added).

**Rationale:**

Kebab-case is the conventional casing for URLs and file paths (GitHub Pages, most static-site generators), so it is a better default than the incidental snake_case the tool started with. Making it a linter rule rather than a path-rendering translation keeps one invariant -- an element's key is its identity, path segment, and slug, unchanged -- while still letting a project choose its own convention and enforcing it consistently, the same way E001-E004 already enforce the tree's other structural invariants.
